description: Generalized computer-vision movement-to-sound & musical regime rules applicable to any mechanism, science explainer, UI, documentary, or pixel-art video.

acoustic_design_principles.harmonic_bed_headroom: Use low-harmonic (H2/H1 < 0.18) warm triangle sub-bass + soft low-pass filtered ostinato plucks cycling through a minimalist 3-chord loop (e.g. i -> VI -> III or vi -> IV -> I) so 800-8000 Hz remains completely open for discrete visual movement triggers.
acoustic_design_principles.regime_switching: Switch drum/bass rhythm density automatically based on visual scene topology rather than running a static drum beat over the entire video.
acoustic_design_principles.continuous_vs_discrete: Continuous camera/flow movements (zooms, accelerations) map to continuous Hz/semitone pitch glides; discrete sub-part movements (UI text, buttons, blades, collisions, shrinking cells) map to tight <90ms transient ticks, chimes, pings, and pops.

regimes.visual_condition: Opening establisher before first structural beat anchor (< ~7% of video or pre-first major scene setup).
regimes.musical_behavior: Hold back kick & hi-hats; play soft 3-chord ostinato plucks + discrete UI/zoom triggers.
Steady 4-on-the-floor kick + eighth-note low-pass sub-bass pulse + minimalist 3-chord arpeggio bed.

regimes.visual_condition: Sustained multi-second high laminar flow or monotonic energy buildup.
regimes.musical_behavior: Double-time 16th/8th driving sub-bass pulse + multi-bar ascending pitch riser climbing across octaves.

regimes.visual_condition: High dark-void background (>= 70%) with sparse floating/colliding small particles and low large-surface coverage (< 18%).
regimes.musical_behavior: Mute all drums & hi-hats; switch sub-bass to sustained whole-note ambient drone; fire crystalline droplet/bell pings on discrete particle collision peaks.

regimes.visual_condition: Final settling scene after last major cut with declining motion energy.
regimes.musical_behavior: Fade percussion; resolve 3-chord ostinato onto warm sustained tonic triad.

triggers.cv_detector: Positive radial optical-flow divergence + expanding salience second-moment radius.
triggers.pitch_mapping: Continuous upward consonant glide (+12 or +19 semitones) across exact zoom duration.

triggers.cv_detector: Negative radial optical-flow divergence + contracting salience second-moment radius.
triggers.pitch_mapping: Continuous downward consonant glide (-12 or -19 semitones) across exact zoom-out duration.

triggers.cv_detector: Positive step delta of high-contrast monochrome bright pixels in HUD/caption zones.
triggers.pitch_mapping: Ultra-short 20ms 3.1 kHz mechanical typewriter ticks locked to text emergence frames.
Two-note rising fifth (+7 semitones) glassy FM confirmation chime.

triggers.cv_detector: Multi-second (>= 2.5s) sustained laminar flow / energy buildup within a shot.
triggers.pitch_mapping: Multi-bar continuous ascending harmonic pitch ramp + accelerating bass subdivision.

triggers.cv_detector: Sharp positive surge in bright high-chroma emissive pixels (beams, flashes, plasma, sparks).
triggers.pitch_mapping: Filtered air/radiation noise burst paired with sub-bass transient thump.

triggers.cv_detector: Cluster of >= 4 rhythmic motion-energy sub-peaks (2-10 Hz) within a structural or grid shot.
triggers.pitch_mapping: Tactile 75ms pitch-stepped pulse pops (alternating octave/fifth or descending/ascending with object area).

triggers.cv_detector: Motion transient spike inside a micro_ambient_particles regime.
triggers.pitch_mapping: High-register (octaves 5-6) upward-chirping crystalline droplet/ionization bell ping.
